Definition: Moreh, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him)
BiblicalUsage: Moreh = "teacher"; 1) the oak tree at Shechem where Abram stopped when he first entered Canaan; close to the mountains of Ebal and Gerizim; 2) the hill in the valley of Jezreel at which the Midianites were camped when Gideon attacked them
